_what_this_is: Batch 1 of the review-question authoring: ten topics whose stored questions could not be registered as written. Two families authored COLD from identical schema-derived material; a third family adjudicated.
RETROSPECTIVE_WITHOUT_EXCEPTION: All ten topics already held trials when these questions were authored. Every question here is therefore written AFTER its evidence was assembled, and every protocol built on one is a RETROSPECTIVELY registered protocol. An anchor bounds WHEN a text existed; it can never show what was already known. This is a property of the whole corpus and not of this batch: of the 45 live blocked topics, 45 hold trials and 0 do not.

authors.google: agy --model gemini-3.1-pro-high, PINNED on the command line because this installation defaults to GPT-OSS 120B, which is openai-family

method.adjudicator: Claude (anthropic), shown both finished drafts, not one plus a reaction
method.cold: The defective stored question was NOT shown to either author. Showing it would anchor both to the defect being repaired.
method.material: Schema-derived: the union of keys present on trial records across the corpus, 142 distinct. The material declares its own completeness -- which keys each trial carries, which it does not, and every truncated value -- so a refusal for want of EVIDENCE can be told from a refusal for want of a coherent QUESTION.

TWO AGREEMENT RATES, REPORTED SEPARATELY._why_both: In all three splits the two families identified IDENTICAL defects and differed only on whether the defect disqualifies. There are zero factual disagreements. A factual disagreement means someone is wrong; a threshold disagreement means the protocol has not said where the line is -- and only the second is ours to fix. Quoting one number would misreport both.
TWO AGREEMENT RATES, REPORTED SEPARATELY.all_three_splits_ran_the_same_direction: openai refused where google authored, in 3 of 3. That is a systematic family-level difference in disposition, not noise. A cross-family gate on a threshold question measures the families' dispositions rather than the evidence, so the adjudicator's job on a threshold split is to SET THE THRESHOLD, not to pick a side.
TWO AGREEMENT RATES, REPORTED SEPARATELY.confidence_signal: CONCERNS: NONE was returned by openai 0 times in 10 and by google 2 times in 10. On attr-cm google flagged the transplant/CMAD bundling in a sparser round and dropped it to NONE in a richer one -- more context produced a more confident and less careful answer. Where a richer round drops a caveat the sparser round raised, the caveat is weighted. A 'no concerns' answer is not evidence of no concerns.

OUTCOME_CHOICE_RULE_DERIVED_FROM_THIS_BA: Where the two families chose different outcomes, one picked a CONTINUOUS measure both trials share and the other a CATEGORICAL or COMPONENT endpoint -- three instances (attr-cm, pitavastatin, and the shape of cangrelor). The rule that resolves them: USE THE SHARED REGISTERED PRIMARY. Descend to a secondary only where no shared primary exists. pitavastatin has percent change in LDL-C as the registered primary in BOTH trials, so a categorical secondary is wrong there; attr-cm has two hierarchical primaries of different arity, so no shared primary exists and a secondary is legitimate -- provided its definitions are equivalent, which had to be checked by hand and was not equivalent for all-cause mortality.

NEW_QUESTION.text: In patients with transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy, do tafamidis or acoramidis compared with placebo improve change from baseline in 6-minute walk test distance at Month 30?

adjudications.reasoning: Both trials register 6MWT change at Month 30 with EQUIVALENT definitions. Their all-cause-mortality entries are NOT equivalent -- ATTRibute-CM's bundles death, heart transplant and mechanical assist device, ATTR-ACT's does not. Neither registered primary is usable: they are hierarchical Finkelstein-Schoenfeld combinations of different arity (2 components vs 4), so no shared primary exists and descending to a secondary is legitimate here.

adjudications.reasoning: A threshold split resolved toward refusal. The registered primaries genuinely differ: CHAMPION-PHOENIX adds stent thrombosis to the three-part composite used by CHAMPION-PCI and CHAMPION-PLATFORM. A composite that is not the same composite is not a shared outcome. The proposed workaround -- all-cause mortality at 48 hours -- is a component of differing composites, the same shape that required hand-checking on attr-cm, and it is not adopted without a definitional-equivalence check.
